units.source_text: 一日，下了整天的雨，黄昏犹自不停。

en.t: One day, rain had fallen all day long, and even at dusk it still had not stopped.

units.source_text: 雨夜异常岑寂，在殿上侍候的人不多；

en.t: The rainy night was unusually quiet, and there were not many people in attendance at court;

units.source_text: 淑景舍比平日更为闲静。

en.t: Shigeisa was even more secluded and still than usual.

units.source_text: 移灯近案，正在披览图书，

en.t: They moved the lamp closer to the desk and were looking through pictures and books,

units.source_text: 头中将从近旁的书橱中取出用各种彩色纸写的情书一束，

en.t: when To no Chujo took from a nearby bookcase a bundle of love letters written on papers of many colors,

units.source_text: 正想随手打开来看，

en.t: and was just about to open them casually and have a look,

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“这里面有些是看不得的，

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Some of these are not for others to see,

units.source_text: 让我把无关紧要的给你看吧。”

en.t: so let me show you the ones that do not matter."

units.source_text: 头中将听了这句话很不高兴，

en.t: To no Chujo was very displeased when he heard this,

units.source_text: 回答说：“我正想看不足为外人道的心里话呢。

en.t: and replied, "What I want to see are precisely the private feelings that cannot be spoken of to outsiders.

units.source_text: 普通一般的情书，像我们这种无名小子也能收到许多。

en.t: As for ordinary love letters, even nameless fellows like us receive plenty of them.

units.source_text: 我所要看的，是怨恨男子薄情的种种词句，

en.t: What I want to read are all sorts of phrases resenting a man's coldheartedness,

units.source_text: 或者密约男子幽会的书信等。

en.t: or letters secretly arranging a tryst with a man.

units.source_text: 这些才有看的价值呢。”

en.t: Those are the ones truly worth reading."

units.source_text: 源氏公子就准许他看了。

en.t: Prince Genji then allowed him to look at them.

units.source_text: 其实，特别重要而必须隐藏的情书，

en.t: In truth, love letters that were especially important and had to be hidden

units.source_text: 不会随便放在这个显露的书橱里，

en.t: would never be carelessly left in such an exposed bookcase,

units.source_text: 一定深藏在秘密地方。

en.t: but would surely be kept deep away in some secret place.

units.source_text: 放在这里的，都是些次等的无足重轻的东西。

en.t: The ones kept here were all second-rate, inconsequential things.

units.source_text: 头中将把这些情书一一观看，说道：“有这么多形形式式的！”

en.t: To no Chujo examined the love letters one by one and said, "There are so many different kinds!"

units.source_text: 就推量猜度：这是谁写的，那是谁写的。

en.t: He then began guessing and speculating: this one was written by so-and-so, and that one by someone else.

units.source_text: 有的猜得很对，有的猜错了路子，疑惑不决。

en.t: Some of his guesses were quite right, while others went astray, leaving him uncertain.

units.source_text: 源氏公子心中好笑，并不多作解答，

en.t: Prince Genji found it amusing in his heart and did not give many answers,

units.source_text: 只是敷衍搪塞，把信收藏起来。

en.t: but merely brushed him off and put the letters away.

units.source_text: 随后说道：“这种东西，你那里一定很多吧。

en.t: Afterward he said, "You must have plenty of this sort of thing yourself.

units.source_text: 我倒想看些。

en.t: I would rather like to see some of them.

units.source_text: 如果你给我看了，我情愿把整个书橱打开来给你看。”

en.t: If you show me yours, I will gladly open the whole bookcase and show it to you."

units.source_text: 头中将说：“我的，恐怕你看不上眼吧。”

en.t: To no Chujo said, "I am afraid mine would not be worthy of your notice."

units.source_text: 说过之后，他就发表他的感想：

en.t: After saying this, he began to express his thoughts:
